scope: Offline reproducibility; do not allocate or rerun GPU experiments to verify these reports.
extract_tools: Extract independent-audits.tar.gz to <tools>. The source helper from the prior batch is already present in the frozen checkout.
private_raw: Extract the full timing archive to <private>/attempt01; use the original private admission archive for the admission-only outer report.
public_raw: Extract raw-public.tar.gz into <public>; it contains raw/ and its embedded public-manifest.json. Publication checking also needs the separately published manifest beside raw/.

prior_bootstrap.requirement: Original complete inventory from the earlier private objective-values archive; public inventory-only derivation cannot reproduce exact provenance checks.

report_identity: Output paths must be fresh; auditors reject overwrite. Reports bind the original source/inputs by SHA256. Preserve the exact archived scripts rather than reformatting them.
private_scope: Full binary/native/fixture evidence remains in original private archives; public results support measurement reanalysis but do not substitute for every native/import provenance dependency.
